subject: SP-204 leveling debate: IC L6 (Staff) vs Manager alignment - decision needed
messages:
From: neha_kapoor
To: aditya_rao, laura_bennett, marcus_lin, tessa_morgan
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Candidate SP-204: proposed leveling and offer packet

Team — attaching the candidate packet for Sofia Patel (SP-204). Quick summary: senior ML engineer, 8+ years, recent org lead experience (managed a team of 3 at prior company) but candidate has expressed strong preference for IC track.

Recommendation from recruiting: target L6 (Staff IC) given technical depth and product impact, base $230k, equity 0.6% (4-year), sign-on $25k. If leadership prefers manager title we can offer L6 Manager (people manager track) with same comp band but require manager sign-off on headcount.

Attachments: SP204_Comp_Sheet.xlsx, SP204_Resume.pdf

Requesting leveling sign-off by EOD Thursday so we can issue verbal. Note: comp numbers are within Q4 bands but final approval from People & VP Eng required for manager track.

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao
To: neha_kapoor, laura_bennett
Cc: marcus_lin
Date: 2026-12-01T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate SP-204: proposed leveling and offer packet

Thanks Neha — I support the L6 Staff (IC) recommendation. Rationale:
- Candidate demonstrated high individual technical ownership (led architecture for a product line) during on-site.
- Prefers IC trajectory; has publicly shipped MLP-based ranking infra and we need that expertise for scale.
- Hiring for an IC at this level fits our roadmap (no immediate direct reports required).

If we put them in a manager role to justify title, we'll risk mismatch with candidate preference and future retention. Proposed offer (if sign-off): base $235k, equity 0.65%, $25k sign-on to make counteroffer-competitive.

Action: need People confirmation on band flexibility and final VP approval if we exceed midpoint.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Staff ML Eng (Hiring Manager)

From: marcus_lin
To: aditya_rao, neha_kapoor
Cc: laura_bennett
Date: 2026-12-01T12:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate SP-204: proposed leveling and offer packet

On 2026-12-01, neha_kapoor wrote:
> Recommendation from recruiting: target L6 (Staff IC) ...

I appreciate the IC argument, but based on interview feedback (led a small eng team and responsible for roadmap prioritization), there is a strong case for manager track. Two operational asks:
1) If we extend a manager title, do we have headcount approval for a manager at this band? That could impact hiring plan in Q1.
2) What's the delta in comp budget between L6 IC and L6 Manager here? If negligible, manager title might be OK.

If we keep IC, fine — but want to ensure we aren't creating upgrade pressure (candidate later asking for promotion to manager without openings). Need People input on promotion path expectations.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Machine Learning

From: laura_bennett
To: aditya_rao, marcus_lin, neha_kapoor
Date: 2026-12-02T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate SP-204: proposed leveling and offer packet

Thanks all — some guidance from People/Comp: attached leveling_guidance_v4.pdf and comp_bands_q4.xlsx. TL;DR:
- L6 (Staff) IC / L6 (Manager) are both valid at band level 6; compensation overlap exists but expectations differ (IC evaluated on breadth/depth of technical impact; Manager evaluated on people management and org outcomes).
- For manager track we need an approved manager headcount slot and routing through People Ops headcount request (HCM ticket).
- Comp delta: typical midpoint delta between IC and Manager at L6 is ~$10k base, but total comp (equity) can be equivalent depending on negotiations.

Given candidate preference for IC, People recommends offering L6 Staff IC. If Leadership (Marcus/Tessa) wants manager title for org reasons, escalate headcount request ASAP — that route will take 48-72 hours.

Next steps: if you want to proceed with L6 Staff, confirm final comp numbers and Neha will prepare verbal. If you want manager route, Marcus/Aditya to confirm and we will open HCM.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Talent & People Strategy

From: aditya_rao
To: tessa_morgan
Cc: neha_kapoor, laura_bennett, marcus_lin
Date: 2026-12-03T15:10:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Candidate SP-204: proposed level & ask for VP sign-off

Tessa — forwarding the thread. Quick summary: candidate strongly prefers IC track; recruiting + People recommend L6 Staff IC. Marcus raised manager-title option (operational reasons) but there is no open manager headcount and that path will delay hire.

My recommendation: approve L6 Staff IC with the following offer: base $235k, equity 0.65% (4y), sign-on $25k, start date target Feb 1. Rationale: immediate technical needs on ranking infra, candidate fit for IC responsibilities, lower operational friction.

Attachments: proposed_offer_packet_SP204.pdf

If you prefer manager title we can pause and open headcount request, but I recommend moving forward with IC to avoid losing candidate.

Thanks for quick read — need final by tomorrow morning so recruiting can issue verbal.

- Aditya

From: tessa_morgan
To: aditya_rao, neha_kapoor, laura_bennett
Cc: marcus_lin
Date: 2026-12-04T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Candidate SP-204: proposed level & ask for VP sign-off

Thanks Aditya — I reviewed the packet and agree with People & Hiring. Approve L6 Staff (IC) for Sofia Patel. Approvals:
- Base: $235,000 approved
- Equity: 0.60% (we'll round to 0.6% and give a one-time early-career refresh eligibility)
- Sign-on: $25,000 approved

Conditions: recruiting to confirm candidate preference for IC in verbal; People to document promotion pathway if candidate later requests manager responsibilities. If candidate insists on manager title, we will open HCM headcount, but hire should not be delayed for that.

Neha — please proceed with verbal and get candidate confirmation; loop Legal for offer letter template and comp approvals. Aditya/Marcus — please prepare onboarding plan and first-90 roadmap.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
VP Engineering
